title: Developer Onramp: Localization, Docs-site Ops, and Canonical Fixes Playbook
content:
Overview

This playbook covers three areas that regularly slow down new integrations: SDK localization (i18n) readiness, docs-site operations (canary, staging and translation pipelines), and a short list of canonical fixes for the most common onramp support issues. It is meant as a single operational reference for engineering, Docs and Support during SDK ship weeks and customer trials.

Goals
- Cut mean-time-to-first-success (MTTFS) for new SDK adopters by 30% with localized examples and a repeatable docs deploy pipeline.
- Give Support canonical fixes for the top 8 devx issues so 60% of triageable tickets are resolved without engineering.
- Keep docs releases low-friction (canary -> staged -> prod) with clear rollback and telemetry hooks.

Audience
- DevX engineers and tech writers shipping SDK examples and docs.
- Support engineers handling integration issues.
- Product engineers who own SDKs and client libraries.

Scope and non-goals
- In scope: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Go snippets; docs-site content lifecycle; translation handoff and CI checks; fixes for common API/SDK errors.
- Out of scope: localization of legal or marketing copy; mobile SDKs beyond samples.

Prerequisites
1) All SDK examples live in redwood/devx-examples (branch: main).
2) Docs-site is served from docs.redwood-inference.internal using a static site generator with the i18n plugin (locales in /i18n/*.json).
3) CI: GitHub Actions workflows docs-canary.yml, docs-staged.yml, docs-prod.yml.
4) The sample harness must emit telemetry.events.example_load, telemetry.tags.locale and telemetry.context.sdk_version.

Quickstart: Localized SDK Example Bundle
1. git clone git@github.com:redwood/devx-examples.git && cd devx-examples
2. ./scripts/bootstrap-dev.sh
3. ./scripts/generate-localized-examples --locales=en,es,fr --sdk=python
4. npm run docs:local -- --locale=fr
5. Check the staging stream (kinesis-devx-staging) for:
   {"event":"example_load","locale":"fr","sdk":"python","version":"0.10.0"}
6. Open a PR with the i18n diffs and add the docs-canary-request label.

SDK Localization Checklist (per release)
- [ ] Sample text keys are externalized; no hard-coded English strings.
- [ ] Translation-ready README and captions in /i18n/{locale}.json.
- [ ] Code comments stay in English; add short localized captions under // LOCAL: ...
- [ ] Locale smoke tests in tests/smoke/{locale}/example_test.py.
- [ ] Bump TELEMETRY_SCHEMA if fields are added and notify analytics@redwood.com.

Table: Supported Example Locales and Priority
Locale | Priority | Owner | Notes
------ | -------- | ----- | -----
en (English) | high | devx-eng | baseline; all CI gates run against en
es (Spanish) | medium | intl-ops | LATAM, EU-ES
fr (French) | medium | intl-ops | EU-FR customers
de (German) | low | intl-ops | on request

Docs-site Operating Procedure (canary -> staged -> prod)
1) Authoring and PRs
   - Branch in docs-content with locale JSONs under /i18n.
   - Attach smoke test output (smoke-{sha}.zip).
   - Label the PR docs-canary-request or docs-staged-request.
2) Canary deploy (triggered by docs-canary-request)
   - docs-canary.yml builds and deploys to docs-canary.redwood-inference.internal.
   - Required checks: build exit 0, i18n-linter (no missing keys), smoke-test artifacts, at least one example_load event.
   - Rollback: revert the PR or run docs-canary-rollback.
3) Staged deploy (after 24h of Canary uptime and signoff)
   - Add docs-staged-request. The ops lead runs ./tools/promote_docs.sh --from=canary --to=staged --approve="<approver>"
   - Staged URL: docs-staged.redwood-inference.internal; translators run QA here.
4) Prod promote
   - Window: M-Th 10:00-16:00 PT. Approvals: 2 reviewers (author + docs eng). Promote with --to=prod and watch SLOs for 30min.

Operational SLOs during promote windows
- Build success rate >= 99% (30-day rolling).
- Canary smoke-tests pass within 15 minutes of deploy.
- No production downtime > 1 minute from a docs push.

Canonical Support Issues and Fixes
Issue A: SDK example fails to authenticate (401)
- Detection: "error=unauthorized, code=401, hint=apiKey"; Support reruns the repro script with -v.
- Root cause: REDWOOD_API_KEY unset or an expired demo key.
- Fix:
  1. echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY
  2. If missing, have the customer create a key in the console (internal:product-docs/create-api-key).
  3. For expired keys, rotate and confirm scopes include [inference:invoke, metrics:read].
  4. Add a fail-fast check to the sample.
- Owner: Support, escalating to the SDK owner if the repro fails.

```python
import os
api_key = os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')
if not api_key:
    raise RuntimeError('Missing REDWOOD_API_KEY environment variable. Create one at https://console.redwood-inference.internal/settings/api-keys')
```

Issue B: Streaming responses stall mid-stream
- Detection: first tokens arrive, then the open connection carries no bytes.
- Root cause: keepalive mismatch or proxy buffering.
- Fix:
  1. Test the raw stream: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -N "https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/stream?..."
  2. If curl works, use chunked transfer decoding and socket keepalive: true in the SDK.
  3. Fall back to poll-based generation with a 5s polling timeout.
- Owner: SDK eng + DevX docs.

Issue C: Localized examples show placeholders ("__MISSING__")
- Detection: i18n-linter failure in CI.
- Root cause: translations not merged or keys renamed in a refactor.
- Fix: npm run i18n-lint -- --locale=es; ./tools/i18n-report --sha <pr-sha>; rebase and run ./scripts/merge-i18n.sh; flag translators for missing strings.
- Owner: Docs + Intl-ops.

Issue D: No example_load events in staging
- Root cause: wrong telemetry endpoint or schema mismatch.
- Fix: confirm TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT points at staging ingestion; run ./scripts/run-smoke --verbose | jq .; check TELEMETRY_SCHEMA.
- Owner: DevX instrumentation owner.

Emergency rollback recipe (docs-site)
1. Revert the offending PR: git revert --no-edit <merge-commit> && push.
2. ./tools/docs_rollback --env=canary --commit=<last-good-commit>
3. Notify #devx and #sre-channels with the incident summary template.
4. Hold a postmortem within 72 hours for developer-impacting incidents.

Telemetry and Monitoring
- Events: example_load, example_error, docs_build_status
- Dashboards: DevX -> Examples Overview, Docs -> Build Health, Support -> Top SDK Errors
- Alerts: Build failure rate > 10% in 1h (PagerDuty to Docs oncall); missing telemetry for a deployed smoke run (Slack #devx-monitor).

Owner matrix
- DevX Docs (authoring + i18n): Marisol Vega (owner)
- Intl-ops (translation & QA): Sana Ribeiro
- SDK engineering: Evan Park
- Support triage lead: Luis Moreno

Contact and escalation
- Blocked promotes: #devx-ops on Slack, pager docs-oncall@redwood-inference.internal
- Telemetry contract: analytics@redwood-inference.internal

Revision history
- 2025-04-28: Initial version by Marisol Vega
- 2025-08-14: Added streaming troubleshooting and telemetry checks (review: Evan Park)

End of playbook
